entities.name: Nebojša Pavković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nebojša Pavković was a Serbian army general who served as Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Yugoslavia from February 2000 to June 2002. He also served as the Commander of Third Army of the Armed Forces of Serbia during the Kosovo War, from December 1998 to February 2000. In 2009, Pavković was convicted by the ICTY of war crimes during the Kosovo War and sentenced to 22 years in prison.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nebojša Pavković was a Serbian army general who served as Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Yugoslavia from February 2000 to June 2002. He also served as the Commander of Third Army of the Armed Forces of Serbia during the Kosovo War, from December 1998 to February 2000. In 2009, Pavković was convicted by the ICTY of war crimes during the Kosovo War and sentenced to 22 years in prison.
